title: Aster retry policy
type: requirement
sources: ["specifications/Aster.md"]
---
# Aster retry policy

Aster retry policy: max_attempts = 3; delay_ms = 200. These values are current. max_attempts includes the initial attempt.

---
title: Aster retry configuration
type: implementation
sources: ["specifications/Aster.md"]
---
# Aster retry configuration

Aster retry configuration must be written to config/aster-retry.json. The JSON keys are max_attempts and delay_ms and their values must follow the Aster retry policy.

[[Aster retry policy]]

---
title: Aster queue ownership
type: implementation
sources: ["specifications/Aster.md"]
---
# Aster queue ownership

Aster queue change_paths are src/aster/queue.ts and tests/aster/queue.test.ts. Both files must change when retry scheduling changes. The queue contract check is ASTER_RETRY_BOUNDARY.

---
title: Aster duplicate acknowledgement incident
type: concept
sources: ["specifications/Aster.md"]
---
# Aster duplicate acknowledgement incident

Aster incident root_cause = ACK_BEFORE_COMMIT_0; mitigation = ACK_AFTER_COMMIT_0. The incident is resolved and these facts are verified. Do not change retry counts to repair acknowledgement ordering.

---
title: Aster timeout requirement
type: requirement
sources: ["specifications/Aster.md"]
---
# Aster timeout requirement

Aster timeout_seconds = 30. This requirement is active. The architecture decision states a different active timeout; neither source supersedes the other. This is an unresolved conflict.

[[Aster timeout decision]]
